analyst.summary: Finolex Cables grew revenue strongly this quarter and over FY26, but full-year profit barely grew (up just ~2%) despite ~19% revenue growth, because more than half of FY26's reported net profit came from non-operating other income rather than the core cables business. The company also let its supplier payment period stretch out significantly during the year - a working-capital shift worth watching. The stock looks statistically cheap on a simple price-to-earnings basis, but that reading is distorted by the non-operating income propping up the earnings figure the multiple is based on.
